subject: CloudSync follow-up: GDPR role alignment and contract options
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Harper <olivia@cloudsync.com>, Marcus Brown <marcus.brown@procureco.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Quick recap + next steps from today's GDPR/security call

Hi Olivia / Marcus —

Thanks for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on the GDPR & contracting questions that came up.

Summary:
- CloudSync is evaluating Redwood for batch sync and in-app enrichment; primary concern is cross-border processing and vendor contractual language (DPA + SCC module).
- You asked whether Redwood can act as Data Processor for the EU data we will send, and whether we support the SCC "Module 2" pathway your legal team prefers.
- SOC 2 and HIPAA posture were requested to validate security controls for your compliance team.

Requested next steps (suggested timeline):
1) You to share a short DPA request document (legal) — action: CloudSync Legal — by 2027-09-30.
2) Redwood to provide SCC module options matrix and confirm controller/processor alignment on our standard DPA — action: Redwood (Aisha & Legal) — by 2027-10-05.
3) Redwood to attach most recent SOC 2 report for tech review — action: Redwood (Dylan) — by 2027-10-01.

I've attached a simple deck and will follow up with our SCC options spreadsheet to make the module trade-offs explicit. If your legal team prefers a call, we can schedule a 30-minute slot next week.

Thanks,
Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attach: CloudSync_intro_deck.pdf

--
Redwood Inference | developer-first inference runtime
From: Olivia Harper <olivia@cloudsync.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>
Cc: CloudSync Legal <legal@cloudsync.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 10:20:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps from today's GDPR/security call

Hi Aisha —

Appreciate the clear recap. CloudSync Legal attached a short DPA request template (see attached) and flagged that they prefer an SCC pathway compatible with Module 2 (standard processor addition) because our product will route EU personal data via an EU region. A few clarifying questions from legal and procurement:

- Can Redwood take Processor role in the DPA as drafted (yes/no + any redlines you usually see)?
- If we opt for Module 2, do you have a standard SCC addendum or is the SCC language embedded in the DPA?
- We also need the most recent SOC 2 report (or SOC 2 Type II summary) and confirmation of your data residency controls.

Marcus (procurement) — are you ok to receive Redwood's SCC options matrix and proposed timelines?

I'll attach the DPA request in my next reply (legal asked to hold the template until we confirm Redwood's alignment).

Best,
Olivia
Olivia Harper
Head of Partnerships, CloudSync Solutions
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>
To: CloudSync Legal <legal@cloudsync.com>, Olivia Harper <olivia@cloudsync.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 08:45:00 -0400
Subject: Fwd: DPA request + internal ask (SOC2 & SCC mapping)

Forwarding CloudSync legal request into our security & legal owners — tagging Dylan and David for the SOC 2 and SCC / controller-processor mapping details.

A few notes for our internal thread:
- CloudSync's preference: processor role for Redwood; SCC Module 2 preferred.
- They will share a short DPA request doc but want to know if we can sign as Processor without redlines, or if we require a vendor-specific addendum.
- CloudSync routes EU data to eu-1 region; ask infra for confirmation of regional isolation and KMS scope.

Dylan — can you confirm we can provide the redacted SOC 2 Type II (2026) and whether there are any datapath caveats when running in eu-1?
David — can Legal confirm whether we support Module 2 SCC addendum or if our DPA embeds SCC language (and any negotiation points)?

I'm attaching the SCC options spreadsheet I'm going to share with CloudSync so they can pick the preferred module without sifting legalese.

attach: Redwood_SCC_options_matrix.xlsx

Thanks team — hoping to close this qualifier quickly if we can satisfy the basic asks.

Aisha
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>, CloudSync Legal <legal@cloudsync.com>, Olivia Harper <olivia@cloudsync.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 11:10:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Fwd: DPA request + internal ask (SOC2 & SCC mapping)

Hi all —

Short answers from Security/Compliance:
- SOC 2: we can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report for 2026; I'll attach the PDF and a 1-page summary. Expect no issues for your compliance review.
- Regional isolation: eu-1 deploys are logically and physically segregated; we use customer-scoped KMS keys for encryption at rest when customers request EU-only keys.
- Data paths: for sync workloads we maintain strict egress rules — metadata and logs are accessible to operator teams but PII payloads stay in the region unless you explicitly enable cross-region replication.

On SCC module: technically we support the Module 2 pattern you described; Legal will need to confirm whether we accept the customer's preferred module as an addendum or prefer embedding SCC language in our DPA. From a controls perspective Module 2 is fine.

Attached: SOC2-report-2026.pdf

Happy to jump on a call with CloudSync Legal to walk through the SOC 2 highlights.

Thanks,
Dylan
Director, Security Engineering
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Harper <olivia@cloudsync.com>, CloudSync Legal <legal@cloudsync.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 05 Oct 2027 15:40:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps — next actions and timeline

Hi Olivia / legal team —

Thanks for the patience. Short confirmation and next steps so we can move to contracting:

1) Redwood confirms we are willing to sign as Processor; typical redlines: limited audit frequency and standard liability caps — we'll flag any non-standard requests.
2) We support an SCC Module 2 addendum — we can either expose the module as a separate SCC addendum you append to the DPA, or embed the equivalent module language into our standard DPA. If you prefer separate module addendum, we'll send our draft for quick review.
3) SOC 2 (redacted) is attached and Dylan is available for an intro call.

Proposed timeline:
- 2027-10-07: Redwood sends SCC addendum draft (if you want Module 2 as an addendum).
- 2027-10-12: Contracting sync (30 min) with CloudSync Legal to walk redlines.

Olivia — please send the DPA request template when you're ready and we'll slot it into Legal's review queue.

Next step for procurement: Marcus, please confirm if procurement needs any additional pricing/commitment language before we spin up the contracting thread.

Cheers,
Aisha
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
